description: qBittorrent is a lightweight BitTorrent client with a full Web UI. This package bundles the official qBittorrent-nox build (standard edition, not Enhanced) as a native Synology DSM 7 package.
description_chs: qBittorrent 是一款轻量级 BitTorrent 客户端，提供完整的 Web 管理界面。本套件封装官方 qBittorrent-nox 标准版（非 Enhanced 增强版），无需 Docker 即可在群晖 DSM 7 上原生运行。
